translations.web: Confuse them, Lord, and confound their language, for I have seen violence and strife in the city.
translations.bsb: O Lord, confuse and confound their speech, for I see violence and strife in the city.
translations.kjv: Destroy, O Lord, and divide their tongues: for I have seen violence and strife in the city.
